description: This file defines the ConditionalTernary class, which is a custom node for the Twig templating engine that represents a ternary conditional expression. It handles the compilation of the ternary operator and specifies which operands should be escaped.

classes.name: ConditionalTernary
classes.description: A custom Twig node representing a ternary conditional expression, capable of compiling itself into PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ConditionalTernary node with test, true, and false expressions, and the line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the ternary expression by compiling its child nodes.

methods.name: getOperandNamesToEscape
methods.description: Returns the list of operand node names that should be escaped during rendering, specifically 'left' and 'right'.
